company.text: Broad Clinical Labs (BCL) was established in **October 2023** as a **wholly owned subsidiary** of the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, building on the former Clinical Research Sequencing Platform. It is a **CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited** lab at **27 Blue Sky Drive, Burlington, MA**, providing genomic testing and data generation for translational research and precision medicine. Leadership: **Niall Lennon, PhD** (Chair and CSO), **Heidi Rehm, PhD, FACMG** (CMO and Clinical Lab Director), **Sean Hofherr** (Chief of Clinical Strategy and Product Development); Broad director **Todd Golub** sits on its board. In **May 2025** BCL partnered with **Roche** to pilot SBX sequencing, starting with trio WGS for critically ill newborns and extending to bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing.
